references.text: Ehud is introduced as left-handed, and he makes a sword that he fastens to his right thigh—this prepares the action in verse 21 where he draws the sword with his left hand.
Jael kills Sisera by driving a tent peg through his temple—a similar bold act by someone who kills an enemy leader with a piercing weapon.
Saul pierces himself with his own sword—the use of a sword to pierce the body as the cause of death.
Abner thrusts the spear shaft into Asahel's belly—the same body area (the abdomen) is pierced by a weapon.
Joab stabs Abner in the belly and kills him—the same method of killing by stabbing in the belly.
Rekab and Baana stab Ish-Bosheth and kill him—an assassination against a leader while he rests.
Joab stabs Amasa in the belly with his sword—the same method of killing by thrusting the sword into the belly.
